verdict.rationale: The pack documents an official CLI, an MCP server, an ACP agent harness, and an open Nostr NIP-29 wire protocol that third-party clients can speak. None of these is an official language SDK or client library for building against Buzz. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is not even a published API spec to generate an SDK from. A collaboration platform could reasonably ship SDKs, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence that Buzz does.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
